about.en: ubik is a fixed-supply memecoin launched through the Pons launchpad on Robinhood Chain, trading in Uniswap v4 pools paired against a tokenized gold token. It has no project website of its own; its canonical reference is the Pons launchpad page for its contract, 0x812486EAea648819853F8E372dc9f1516C7868Bd.
